question: pelanggan mana yg dealnya ditangani lebih dari 2 sales berbeda
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, uniqExact(r.rep_id) AS jumlah_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING uniqExact(r.rep_id) > 2

question: nilai deal rata-rata per wilayah pelanggan dan tim sales utk deal won
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS customer_region, r.team, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY customer_region, r.team

question: aktivitas call 30 hari terakhir: nama customer + tim sales
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, c.name AS customer_name, r.team FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'call' AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30)

question: sentimen negatif bulan ini, tampilkan perusahaan pelanggan dan nama sales
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, c.company, r.name AS rep_name FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.sentiment = 'negative' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(today())

question: aktivitas minggu lalu dgn pelanggan SMB, nama customer dan wilayah sales ikut
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, c.name AS customer_name, r.region FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.segment = 'SMB' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfWeek(subtractWeeks(today(), 1), 1) AND a.timestamp < toStartOfWeek(today(), 1)

question: total durasi aktivitas per pelanggan oleh tim Inbound 30 hari terakhir, 10 teratas
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE r.team = 'Inbound' AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_durasi DESC LIMIT 10

question: jumlah demo per sales per bulan tahun ini, tampil id dan nama sales
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_demo FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'demo' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, bulan

question: aktivitas oleh sales bernama Eko, sertakan nama customer dan nama sales

question: deal yg dipegang sales bernama Hendra, tampilkan nama customer dan nama sales

question: pelanggan Silver yg punya tiket terbuka dan deal pipeline, id dan nama customer

question: tiket resolved bulan lalu dari customer yg punya deal won, sebut nama customer dan company

question: tiket high atau urgent yang terbuka, dari customer yg dealnya dipegang tim Inbound, plus nama customer
